text_en: I'm sorry you ended up here; it doesn't seem like it's your time yet. I mean, if you looked 400 years old like Jivan, I'd understand, but...
(And even if you weren't, you could hear me even inside the house).

As I was saying, I know it can be a bit sad at first, but you get used to it in the end. Jivan became my family and, even though he's a grouchy old hermit, I've never felt alone ever since he took me in.
You could say that I owe him my life, or my second life, that is...
I can't lie to you. I love it when adventurers like you come to Hafin. Do you know how many times I've imagined myself traveling around Terragaya in armour like that, facing danger?!
Jivan is too protective of me. He doesn't let me set foot outside the city. It'll be hard for me to convince him that I can defend myself.
But I won't bore you with my problems. Stop by every once in a while. I look forward to hearing all about your adventures!
